newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Expeditors EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Expeditors EPS view raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said it raised its 1996 EPS estimates on Expeditors International of Washington Inc to $1.87 from $1.85, primarily because the company posted third quarter earnings per share of $0.60. The earnings were $0.02 higher than projected.
--It is maintaining its 1997 earnings per share estimate at $2.30.

--EVEREN also said it downgraded Expeditors' stock to market performer from outperformer based on the stock price achieving a historic high P/E multiple at its six-month price target of $42. "Based on strong fundamentals, we would likely get more aggressive with our near-term rating if it moves back toward the lower quarter of our expected 12-month range of $33 to $52," EVEREN said in a report.
